description: This file defines the ObservableGrain class, which implements grain behavior for testing internal grain call handling and observable patterns in an Orleans-based project. It includes methods for streaming values, handling errors, completing or failing the stream, deactivating the grain, and tracking incoming calls.

classes.name: ObservableGrain
classes.description: A test grain class implementing observable patterns and call filtering for Orleans testing scenarios.

methods.name: GetValues
methods.description: Returns an asynchronous stream of string values from the internal channel.

methods.name: GetValuesWithError
methods.description: Generates an asynchronous stream of integers, with the ability to throw errors at specified points.

methods.name: Complete
methods.description: Completes the internal update channel, signaling no more data will be sent.

methods.name: Fail
methods.description: Completes the internal update channel with an exception, signaling a failure.

methods.name: OnNext
methods.description: Writes a string data item to the internal update channel.

methods.name: GetIncomingCalls
methods.description: Returns a list of recorded incoming call interface and method names.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Records the incoming call context and invokes the next step in the call pipeline.
